title: Chapter 247: Subjugating Goode
content:
Chapter 247: Subjugating Goode

At this stage, almost no one is immune to control skills, and once controlled, they can only take the opponent's skills head-on.

This is also the reason why Wang Shuo hates bosses with control skills the most.

Launch "Iron Chain Binding" again, followed by "Dragon Strike".

Wang Shuo did not use "Flame Breath" this time, he was afraid that a combo would kill Gude in seconds.

Even so, Gude only had a few hundred points of health left.

"Thank you!"

The winner has been decided. Although Gude is unwilling, he is not someone who can't afford to lose!

"Thank you, Lord, for mercy."

At this time, the system prompt sounded.

[High-level general Gude joins Wana Village. 】

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he heard the prompt. As expected, he is a high-level general and even sent a system prompt.

"Please get up quickly."

Seeing Gude bowing, Wang Shuo quickly put away his weapon and helped him up.

He looked eager to find talents.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also took out a drop of water of life and gave it to Gude.

"Good, from now on, we are a family. This drop of water of life can help you recover quickly. You can't blame me for being too heavy-handed just now!" Wang Shuo said apologetically.

"I dare not. Lord, don't mind. We are just competing and learning. Swords have no eyes. I can only blame myself for my inferior skills!" Good laughed bitterly.

Wang Shuo was ashamed after hearing this.

If the opponent had no equipment bonus and no suitable weapons, how could he defeat a senior general head-on.

"Good, I plan to appoint you as the leader of the archers. What do you think?"

"As long as the lord orders, I will definitely live up to the lord's trust."

"Okay, haha!"

Gong Zheng and the other person on the side also laughed.

In the evening, Wang Shuo held a banquet in the lord's mansion, one to celebrate the joining of the senior general Good, and the other to connect with the feelings of the high-level officials of the territory.

"Yan Fujie, how is the recent construction of the city wall going?"

Yan Fujie quickly swallowed the chicken in his mouth, stood up, and replied: "My Lord, it will be completed in two days. The number of craftsmen has increased a lot recently, and the proficiency of the old craftsmen has also been improved, so the construction speed has increased a lot."

Yan Fujie was still a little nervous. He was fortunate to attend such a high-level banquet, which showed that the Lord still valued him very much.

As long as he can do his job well, he will sooner or later become a core member of Wana Village.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction, raised his glass, and toasted him.

Yan Fujie was flattered and quickly raised his glass and drank it all.

Also, Wu Dong from the blacksmith shop, Liu Feifei from the clinic, Yan Yu from the tailor shop and others attended the banquet.

All the leaders of important positions in Wana Village were invited to the banquet.

Wang Shuo asked about the situation one by one and knew what was going on.

After the banquet, Wang Shuo called Duan Wenxi, Zou Yuanjie, Gude, and Ayub to the side hall.

At this time, Xiulan, the maid Duan Wenxi chose for Wang Shuo, brought fruit tea.

"I want to keep you guys here to discuss the future development of our Wana Village."

Several people looked at Wang Shuo with different expressions on their faces.

"It is imperative to use troops against Nanshan Group. But the current strength of Nanshan Group far exceeds that of our Wana Village. Do you have any suggestions?"

Gude frowned, thinking that he had just joined Wana Village and had not yet established a firm foothold. If he did not perform well, wouldn't his colleagues look down on him?
